resources.name: Shell model interatomic potential parameters for Al2SiO5

access.notes: Parameters are described in Rao et al., Phys. Rev. B 60 (1999) 12061. The agent must extract the potential parameters from this reference.
The structure (space group Pnnm, lattice constants, fractional coordinates) will be provided in the task instructions; extracted from the paper Table 1.

resources.name: Open-source lattice dynamics software (e.g., Phonopy, GULP, LAMMPS)

access.notes: Any package capable of shell model potential, energy minimization, and phonon DOS calculation may be used.
